UNDERSTANDING SOUND ENERGY
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding sound energy means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Sound Energy.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Sound Energy. Get clear on sound energy before moving on. How would you explain sound energy to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Identify sources of sound in nature,. Clue from the topic: That sound travels in all directions. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• A wave transfers energy without transferring matter permanently from place to place.
• Wave speed: v = fλ, where f is frequency and λ is wavelength.
• Frequency is waves per second (Hz); period T = 1/f.
• Reflection, refraction and diffraction are wave behaviours you must name accurately in exams.
• Keep units consistent: v in m/s, λ in m, f in Hz.
